Leyland Trade is a brilliant white, high-opacity vinyl matt emulsion paint designed for interior walls and ceilings. This water-based paint is ideal for trade professionals and DIYers working on high-traffic living rooms, hallways, and bedrooms. The formula hides surface imperfections easily, providing excellent coverage of 14m²/Ltr. It dries to the touch in 1 to 2 hours and is ready for a second coat in 2 to 4 hours. The wipeable, easy-to-clean finish ensures long-lasting results.
